subject: Exception intake: audit log retention & customer-managed keys (MedSage)
messages:
From: Michael Cooper <michael@medsage.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T14:02:00Z
Subject: Audit retention window + BYOK questions

Irene — thanks again for the demo earlier today. A couple of follow-ups from our compliance and security teams: 

1) Audit logs: our auditors expect a 3-year retention window for admin & access logs. Does Redwood support configurable retention at that horizon, and can we export immutable snapshots for external review?

2) BYOK / KMS: we need to push customer-managed keys for encryption at rest. We also need an exception path if our HSM provider has scheduled maintenance — can Redwood provide temporary escrow or a short-term key rotation workflow?

3) SSO integration: our SAML IdP is strict about session length; we'd prefer tokens aligned to our SSO session.

I've attached a csv inventory of evidence items our auditors expect. Can you confirm whether any of this requires an enterprise/private deployment vs. something we can do on Dedicated?

Michael Cooper
Head of Security Operations, MedSage Health
security@medsage.com
Attachments: evidence_inventory.csv (CSV)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Michael Cooper <michael@medsage.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T15:11:00Z
Subject: Re: Audit retention window + BYOK questions

Michael — thanks for the clear list and the inventory. Looping in Product, Security and Compliance to give a consolidated answer and map action owners. Quick answers up front: 

- Retention: we support configurable retention for audit logs; 3 years is feasible but we need to validate storage/ingestion costs and search performance.
- Export snapshots: yes — we can produce immutable exports (signed manifests). Need to confirm frequency and format your auditors require.
- BYOK: Dedicated and Private support customer-managed KMS integrations. For Hosted, we have options via our BYOK flow but there are limitations on HSM escrow — we need to discuss an exception procedure.
- SSO token/session alignment: we can honor session TTLs via SSO configuration for most session flows; there are caveats around long-running streaming sessions.

Requested next steps: 
1) Marcus — can you estimate dev effort to support 3-year retention on hosted-managed audit indices (indexing/cost + UI export)?
2) Karthik & Neha — please draft the security exception playbook for temporary key escrow/rotation (including required approval gates and audit evidence).
3) Laura — compliance: confirm what format (CSV/JSON/PDF) and signing requirements auditors prefer for immutable snapshots.

Proposed timeline: quick triage today, draft proposal by Tues EOD (2026-08-31), and a customer readout early next week. Michael — are you available for a 30m sync on Mon 2026-08-31?

Thanks — I will centralize the artifacts in the ticket and attach our template.

Irene Choi
Director, Product Operations | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0129

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T18:06:00Z
Subject: Re: Audit retention window + BYOK questions

Thanks — quick product-run notes: 

- Storage model: keeping raw audit events for 3 years is possible but expensive at high ingest rates. We should offer two tiers: "full-fidelity" (raw events, immutable) and "aggregated" (indices with retention-sensitive fields). Recommend offering a configurable retention policy per-account.

- Export: build a signed-export job (S3 + manifest + signed digest). That should be a 2-sprint feature for Dedicated; for Hosted we can scope an initial export-only MVP in 1 sprint (no UI, job triggered by CS/SE).

- Hosted vs Dedicated: for immediate customer needs, we can deliver the export and TTL configuration as a Hosted MVP with an explicit cost note; BYOK/HSM escrow safe-paths require Dedicated/Private for full compliance (HSM attestation + KMS integration). However, we could propose a short-term exception process for Hosted (documented controls + limited-duration keys).

Estimates (rough): 
- Hosted export MVP: 1 sprint (2 engineers, infra support)
- Retention config + storage optimization: 2-3 sprints (backend + infra)
- BYOK escrow workflow + approval UI: 2 sprints (security + product)

I'll sketch a proposed sprint plan and resource ask tomorrow. Marcus

Marcus Lin
Sr. Product Manager, Platform
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T10:37:00Z
Subject: Re: Audit retention window + BYOK questions

On 2026-08-29 at 18:06, Marcus Lin wrote: 
> - BYOK escrow workflow + approval UI: 2 sprints (security + product)

Folks — attaching a short working draft of the exception playbook and required artifacts. Key items I want us to agree on before we present to MedSage: 

1) Exception window: propose maximum 14 days for a temporary escrowed key with mandatory multi-party approval (Customer Sec + Redwood Security Lead + Legal).
2) Audit trail: every key rollover/escrow event must be logged to an append-only audit stream with signed digests and retention for the full requested period (3 years if requested).
3) Evidence package: snapshot exports must include: key-rotation logs, user-admin audit logs, signed manifest of exported files, and a short attestation from Redwood security.
4) Technical limitation: streaming long-lived sessions while honoring external SSO token TTLs — we need a small compromise where streaming tokens are reauthorized every 24 hours; we'll document the gap for the customer.

Attachments: kms-exception-proposal.docx (draft playbook).

Next actions: 
- Laura: please confirm whether attestation language below is sufficient for auditors. 
- Marcus: we'll need a CS-triggered Hosted export job for the immediate ask while we iterate on Dedicated features.
- Irene: schedule the Mon sync (30m) to present these guardrails and the sprint ask.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Security Engineering | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
